title: Update Agent Personas (3–9) and Support Personas to Remove Spec File References
description:
**Plan Context:** Eliminate the `work/WP-###.md` spec files and `work.md` summary index from the ledger workflow, making the ledger the sole source of WP specification content via `ledger_get_work_package`.

**Description:** Update all agent personas (Developer, QA, Security Auditor, Reviewer, Release Engineer, Documentation, Synthesis) to replace spec file input references with `ledger_get_work_package` as the sole source of WP specification content. Review the Ledger Doctor and Knowledge Archiver support personas for any spec file references.

**Scope:**
- `personas/ledger/src/content/3-developer.md` — input reference, workflow step
- `personas/ledger/src/content/4-qa.md` — input reference
- `personas/ledger/src/content/5-security-auditor.md` — input reference
- `personas/ledger/src/content/6-reviewer.md` — input reference
- `personas/ledger/src/content/7-release-engineer.md` — input reference
- `personas/ledger/src/content/8-documentation.md` — input reference
- `personas/ledger/src/content/9-synthesis.md` — input reference
- `personas/ledger-support/src/content/ledger-doctor.md` — review (no matches found)
- `personas/ledger-support/src/content/ledger-knowledge-archiver.md` — review (no matches found)

**Deliverables:**
- Developer persona: spec file input reference replaced with `ledger_get_work_package` description; workflow step updated to remove `work/WP-###.md` reference
- QA persona: spec file input reference replaced with `ledger_get_work_package` reference
- Security Auditor persona: spec file input reference replaced with `ledger_get_work_package` reference
- Reviewer persona: spec file input reference replaced with `ledger_get_work_package` reference
- Release Engineer persona: spec file input reference replaced with `ledger_get_work_package` reference
- Documentation persona: spec file input reference replaced with `ledger_get_work_package` reference
- Synthesis persona: spec file input reference replaced with `ledger_get_work_package` reference
- Ledger Doctor and Knowledge Archiver confirmed to have no spec file references (no changes needed)

**Estimated Complexity:** Low

**Rationale:** The `description` field returned by `ledger_get_work_package` contains the same structured Markdown that agents would read from the spec file. The textual substitutions are nearly identical across all seven personas — each replaces a "spec file" reference with a "tool call" reference.

**Code Observations:** Each persona has 1-2 lines referencing `work/WP-###.md`. The Developer persona has two references (input section at line 31 and workflow step at line ~40). All other personas have a single reference in their input/source-of-truth section. The Ledger Doctor and Knowledge Archiver were searched and confirmed to have zero matches for `work_package_file`, `work/WP-`, or `spec file`.

All persona outputs build successfully: node scripts/build-personas.js completes without errors.
